## Correctness defects

1. **P1 - Editing handles in iOS destroys stable identity metadata.**  
   [PersonFieldEditors.swift:355](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/ios/Haven/Directory/PersonFieldEditors.swift:355), [PersonEditor.swift:159](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/ios/Haven/Directory/PersonEditor.swift:159), [people.ts:1233](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/convex/people.ts:1233)  
   Input: an X handle has `platformId: "123"` and `source: "proven"`; the user merely changes which handle is primary. The editor serializes every handle as only `platform` and `value`; the server preserves `addedAt` but replaces `source` with `typed` and drops `platformId`, so the link is no longer rename-proof. I traced the complete decode-edit-encode-write path and found no metadata restoration. Confidence: certain.

2. **P1 - The production X rename flow creates a duplicate instead of following the stable ID.**  
   [ConvexCaptureSink.swift:13](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/ios/Haven/Capture/ConvexCaptureSink.swift:13), [ConvexCaptureSink.swift:111](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/ios/Haven/Capture/ConvexCaptureSink.swift:111), [people.ts:1420](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/convex/people.ts:1420), [people.ts:1562](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/convex/people.ts:1562), [people.ts:1626](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/convex/people.ts:1626)  
   Input: Mai is stored as `old_name` with X ID `123`; she renames to `new_name`, which is shared from iOS. iOS first saves `new_name` without a platform ID, so value lookup misses and creates a second person; the detached lookup then adds ID `123` to that duplicate without reconciling it with the original. I checked the patch mutation and it only updates the requested person. Confidence: certain.

3. **P1 - Platform-ID lookup can rename a handle onto a username already owned by another person.**  
   [people.ts:389](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/convex/people.ts:389), [people.ts:430](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/convex/people.ts:430), [people.ts:1453](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/convex/people.ts:1453)  
   Input: A owns `{value:"old", platformId:"id-a"}` and B owns `{value:"new"}`; saving `{value:"new", platformId:"id-a"}` selects A by ID and rewrites A to `new`, leaving both A and B indexed under `new`. Neither the merge nor index insertion rechecks the incoming value's existing owner. Confidence: certain.

4. **P1 - The `addPerson` response change has no safe mixed-version rollout.**  
   [people.ts:602](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/convex/people.ts:602), [SearchAdd.tsx:367](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/src/SearchAdd.tsx:367), [vercel.json:2](/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app/vercel.json:2)
